title: Post-election anti-election demonstrations, encampments and related road actions
notes: Opened reporting describes an Army HQ camp established after the October 2022 election, active into January; S042 reproduces an estimate of about 500 at that camp on Jan 2, and S046 reports camp clearances on Jan 9. S048 records Jan 8 roadblocks. This documents cross-month context only: exact campaign ownership, whether every road action belongs to one episode, and whether the broader campaign ended remain unresolved.
